display.purpose: Hero H1 only. Weight 300; the emphasised clause steps to 400 or gold, never bold.

headline.purpose: Section H2s. Weight 300, negative tracking, tight leading.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, numbers, badges. JetBrains Mono, UPPERCASE, 0.34em tracking. 11px is the site-wide floor.

shadows.name: feature-lift
shadows.purpose: Hero-level feature cards only; at most one per page. Everything else separates with 1px hairline borders.

motion.name: ease-out-standard
motion.purpose: The only easing family. Never spring or bounce.

motion.name: duration-card
motion.purpose: Card hover lifts (translateY(-4px), border to gold/20).

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Scroll reveals: opacity 0->1, translateY 24px->0, IntersectionObserver at 0.08, sibling stagger 100-150ms.

motion.name: countup
motion.purpose: Animated stat counters, trigger at 25% visibility.

narrative.overview: A dark, machined space where serious work happens. Near-black canvas (#0A0A0A), warm off-white text, headlines set light (never bold) and one gold accent used the way brass fittings are used on industrial machinery: rarely, deliberately, where your hand goes. The system communicates calm authority for a two-operator NZ AI consultancy whose visitors are sceptical business owners, not developers. Whitespace and type scale carry the hierarchy; ornament is close to zero. It explicitly rejects startup-bro SaaS aesthetics, big-consultancy stock-photo gloss, light-theme corporate minimalism, and AI-guru urgency.
keyCharacteristics: Dark throughout; no light sections, ever
Light-weight Inter headlines at large sizes; negative tracking, tight leading
UPPERCASE JetBrains Mono for labels, numbers, and eyebrows; wide tracking
One gold accent; product accents (blue/teal/green) scoped to their own sub-pages
Full-bleed monochrome photography under heavy dark overlays

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold appears on well under 10% of any viewport. Its rarity is the authority. If two gold elements compete in one fold, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The No Hand-Picked Grey Rule
rules.body: #888, #555, and any other improvised grey are prohibited. Use the two warm grey tokens (#ACA69B, #918B80).

rules.name: The Dim-Small Ban
rules.body: Muted (#918B80) is for body-size text (>=14px) only. Small text and mono labels always use Secondary. Dim + small is unreadable.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Bold Rule
rules.body: Headlines are never bold. Emphasis comes from size, weight-300-vs-400 contrast, or the single gold clause. Bold headlines read as shouting; this brand doesn't shout.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Metadata Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono marks metadata (labels, numbers, tags), never prose. If it's a sentence, it's Inter.

rules.name: The Borders-Before-Shadows Rule
rules.body: Reach for a 1px #FFFFFF12 border first. If a card needs a shadow to be legible, the layout is at fault, not the shadow.

dos: Do keep every surface dark: canvas #0A0A0A, bands #111111. No light sections, ever.
Do set headlines light (300) and large; emphasise with the single gold clause or weight 400.
Do use the two warm greys (#ACA69B, #918B80) for all de-emphasis; migrate any #888/#555 you touch.
Do scope product accents to their sub-page: blue #0078D4 on /copilot, teal #2B8C8C on /openclaw, green #4CAF50 on /builds, gold everywhere else.
Do keep body copy at <=680px measure, leading 1.8.
Do render photography monochrome under a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/75-85), full-bleed.
Do keep motion entrances-only: fade-up 24px, 800ms ease-out, 100-150ms sibling stagger; hover lifts 300-500ms.
donts: Don't use gradient text, hero-metric templates, purple-neon AI aesthetics, or robot imagery.
Don't use stock photography as decoration or any placeholder imagery.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left/right > 1px as accent). The Engine AI accent is the 3px gold TOP bar.
Don't hand-pick greys, ever (#888 and #555 are the named offenders).
Don't use mono for prose, bold for headlines, or all-caps for body copy.
Don't put gold text on light surfaces; that's Gold Ink's (#8A6C2A) job in print contexts only.
Don't add icons by reflex. Near-zero iconography; when genuinely needed: Lucide, 1.5px stroke, gold or white/60, 16-20px.
Don't use exclamation marks, emoji, urgency banners, or countdown timers.
Don't write leverage, synergy, or digital transformation in any UI text.
